research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: BedRock Systems is focused on enhancing security in virtualized environments. They are developing physical memory isolation techniques to ensure secure address space management in virtual systems. Their work on process credential protection aims to safeguard in-guest process credentials by binding them with specific values. Additionally, they are advancing a zero trust endpoint device featuring a formally verified microkernel, which is part of a trusted computing base with active security and policy enforcement. These efforts underscore their commitment to creating a secure computing base from edge to cloud.

product.name: Foundational Runtime Security Layer
product.description: A security layer that operates beneath Linux and container hosts to protect runtime integrity from external exploits.

product.name: Real-time Introspection and Integrity Protection
product.description: Enables monitoring and protection of runtime environments against attacks, including privilege escalation and remote code execution, without adding overhead.

product.name: Strong Runtime Isolation
product.description: Assures memory isolation between container workloads and the host, preventing lateral and vertical escape attempts by attackers.
